note: Seeded from LAYOUT.svg (the owner approved the layout 2026-10-19). Kit frame: x west to east along the coast, +z the sea (the world's NORTH), -z inland. Every quarter carries its lot mix (cultures, PLAN.md section 3), who holds it at game start (holder), its mood, its layer and its ruin level (0 whole, 1 toppled). The site editor saves here.
